question: Should OpenClaw add a public post-subagent-completion/pre-announcement plugin hook, or fold this requirement into a broader lifecycle/delivery hook design?
rationale: The requested behavior changes public plugin API, child session data exposure, and announcement delivery control, so automation should not choose the permanent contract.

options.title: Design a typed hook
options.body: Add a bounded public hook for completion inspection and announcement enrichment or suppression, with docs and tests for ordering and data exposure.

options.title: Fold into broader lifecycle API
options.body: Keep this issue as a requirement under a broader agent/subagent lifecycle hooks design and avoid a one-off hook name.

options.title: Observation only
options.body: Expose only a non-mutating completion event and leave announcement mutation or suppression to separate delivery-policy work.

recommendation.title: Design a typed hook
recommendation.body: Add a bounded public hook for completion inspection and announcement enrichment or suppression, with docs and tests for ordering and data exposure.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent source history and prior API review context make this the strongest routing candidate for the product/security contract choice.
